Parent issue: #409

Stage: test-lanes

## Task

Implement the first bounded phase of #409: introduce explicit .agent test/check lanes and update CI so failures identify whether runtime tests, workflow/action checks, docs hygiene, or shell checks failed. Use the prior investigation on #409 as context. Prefer conservative script/CI changes over a broad refactor: add/adjust .agent/package.json scripts for lane execution and a composed test:ci command; update .github/workflows/test-scripts.yml to npm ci, build once, then run lane commands without rebuilding redundantly. Keep docs validation focused on structural checks such as frontmatter/nav/link shape; do not delete docs checks entirely. If moving docs-specific assertions out of the catch-all runtime suite is feasible, do that narrowly; leave the large envelope.test.ts breakup and shared harness helper refactor for later children unless a small extraction is required. Preserve existing behavior and verify with cd .agent && npm run test:ci, or the closest available equivalent if the lane names differ.
